title: Loving Your Neighbor
definition: Loving your neighbor is obeying God's command to seek the good of others with compassion, truth, mercy, and practical care.
summary: Love of neighbor turns devotion to God into visible compassion and faithful action.
christFocus: Jesus fulfilled the law of love and showed mercy to sinners, enemies, the vulnerable, and the overlooked.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Loving your neighbor is one of the great commands of Scripture. It is not limited to people who are easy, similar, useful, or grateful. It calls believers to seek the good of others because God is love.

Jesus' parable of the Good Samaritan exposes narrow definitions of neighbor. Love crosses convenience, prejudice, fear, and self-protection to show mercy.

Love of neighbor does not abandon truth. It acts with compassion, justice, honesty, patience, and sacrificial care.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often claim love for God while ignoring the needs of people near them. Loving your neighbor matters because genuine faith becomes visible in mercy, truth, and action.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask who God has placed near you to love. Take one practical step of mercy, service, listening, generosity, or truth that reflects Christ's love.
